subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Which open PR should be the canonical implementation of documented OpenAI-compatible `xhigh` reasoning-effort support: this consolidated branch or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703?
rationale: The two branches share the same core implementation but this branch adds a rebase, persistence coverage, and boundary hardening; choosing the durable provider contract and canonical history requires owner intent rather than a mechanical fix.

options.title: Adopt this consolidated PR
options.body: Land this branch if an owner confirms its Responses, registry-persistence, and opt-out hardening are the intended complete contract.

options.title: Adopt the original PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703 as the canonical contribution if maintainers prefer its history and can take any uniquely needed hardening separately.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Pause both proposals if no owner is prepared to accept the expanded provider compatibility contract yet.

recommendation.title: Adopt this consolidated PR
recommendation.body: Land this branch if an owner confirms its Responses, registry-persistence, and opt-out hardening are the intended complete contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies Alex-Govorov as the original contributor for the shared core implementation.
